title: Which country's public broadcaster will announce a boycott of Eurovision 2027 in August 2026 over concerns about the contest's political neutrality?
background: Countries participate in the Eurovision Song Contest through national broadcasters, which decide whether to enter the competition.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : An official statement from the withdrawing broadcaster, corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the country whose public broadcaster announces during August 2026 that it will not participate in the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest, citing concerns about the contest's political neutrality. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The country's common English name.
